data.body:
Dangling caused_by link ceae9de7-8992-47c2-855c-60825331adc3 (target_id '6ed2', provenance explicit) is left in place pending an operator decision. It was written by the close-path bug surprising-fruticose-herring, fixed in Gerrit 3259.

Which 6ed2 was meant: the evidence picks 6ed2-24e5-6985-4faa (traitorous-official-sunbittern), the epic 'Merge held-out twin test modules after the code epics land'.
- This ticket's title begins "6ed2's AC1 glob". The description opens with 'Epic 6ed2-24e5-6985-4faa ... closed on the strength of an acceptance criterion that measured the wrong set' and quotes that epic's AC1 glob.
- This ticket already carries discovered_from -> 6ed2-24e5-6985-4faa, and was closed 2026-11-02 19:17 PST with close_class plan_defect, matching a defect in the epic's acceptance criterion.
- The other match, 6ed2-1e12-0780-4efd (traitorous-equal-nettlefish), is an open code_review artifact from 2026-08-01 for an unrelated Gerrit change. Nothing in it mentions held-out modules.

Why the link was not replaced: neither step goes through a supported command without --force.
- rebar link --dry-run frank-rocky-rat traitorous-official-sunbittern caused_by reports 'Would reject: ... target ticket 6ed2-24e5-6985-4faa has no commit referencing it'. The caused_by rule also says the edge should name the specific change that introduced a defect, not credit an epic, and this defect is in the epic's plan, not a commit.
- rebar unlink resolves the target first, so it cannot address the raw '6ed2' target. Filed as lionly-squarish-xantus.

Options for the operator: keep the edge until lionly-squarish-xantus provides a removal path, then remove it without a replacement (a plan defect has no culprit commit); or have a human remove it now through rebar store maintenance; or have a human record caused_by -> 6ed2-24e5-6985-4faa with an audited --force.
